# netcup_scp_server_metrics (Data Source)

Reads server metrics from the SCP REST API. The raw JSON response is returned so it can be parsed with terraform's jsondecode function.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_scp_server_metrics" "cpu" {
  server_id = 12345
  metric    = "cpu"
  hours     = 1
}

locals {
  cpu_metrics = jsondecode(data.netcup_scp_server_metrics.cpu.json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric` (String) Metric to query. Valid values are `cpu`, `disk`, `network` and `network_packet`.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to query metrics for.

### Optional

- `hours` (Number) Number of hours to look back (maximum 1440).

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Raw JSON response from the SCP metrics endpoint.
